policies.name: No Physical Supercluster Claim Without Evidence
policies.rule: Sheikha may register supercluster readiness, but cannot claim physical supercluster ownership, GPU fleet ownership, or cloud capacity without verified evidence and contract.

policies.name: No Model Training Claim Without Run Evidence
policies.rule: Training, fine tuning, or deployment claims require reproducible run records, data rights, compute evidence, and evaluation reports.

policies.name: Data Rights Before Pipeline
policies.rule: Data ingestion, cleaning, feature engineering, vectorization, and training require source rights, privacy review, and lineage.

policies.name: Cost And Human Approval For External Compute
policies.rule: External cluster, GPU, cloud, or managed AI runtime spend requires human approval and cost guardrails before activation.

policies.name: Monitoring And Drift Required
policies.rule: Inference deployment requires telemetry, model drift monitoring, data drift monitoring, rollback, and incident response.

policies.name: Agent Authority And Audit
policies.rule: Multi-agent execution requires agent identity, permissions, audit trail, safety policy, and human final authority.
